description: Combine several pg.ddx.io calendar feeds into ONE subscription. Give feed paths or URLs as listed by calendar_feeds (e.g. events/region/europe, series/pgconf-eu, teams/committers, people/<8hex>, https://pg.ddx.io/cal/orgs/edb.ics; 1-200). Returns the combined feed's hash, canonical feed list, https url and webcal url. The same selection always yields the same URL.

excludes.description: Feeds whose events are removed from the combination (but not), e.g. events/country/rs or teams/security-team

feeds.description: Feed paths or /cal/ URLs to combine

name: combine_calendars
